findings.title: AI source metadata bypasses the sensitive-data screen
findings.business_impact: When external processing is validly enabled, an authorized request with safe question/label/content but citation= password=synthetic-audit-marker passes checks and sends that metadata to Groq/Gemini. sourceId/sourceType have the same gap. Current disabled provider is not evidence of a live leak.
findings.repair_scope: Screen every field serialized into external prompts, including sourceId/sourceType/citation, with the same bounded secret/PII rules; retain fail-closed policy/consent and no raw-content logs.
findings.repair_acceptance: Synthetic provider-spy tests for secret/PII markers in each metadata field must refuse before availability/complete; safe citations still work. Verify both provider request serializers without external calls.
dependencies: AI processing policy approval required only for live acceptance; local synthetic verification needs no provider

evidence.tests: PASS_REPRODUCTION — 13 synthetic cases on Node24.20.0; 3 spy metadata bypasses, 2 existing-screen controls, 2 consent/class denials, 6 Groq/Gemini serializer mocked-fetch captures
evidence.authority_limit: Production policy/config loader not invoked. Approved-policy activation remains conditional; injected local fake/adapter config is synthetic test setup, not organizational approval.

findings.title: Logical backup success is not persisted into the application catalog or durable manifest
findings.business_impact: The script stores and checks dump bytes, returns an in-memory manifest, prints only status/failure/catalog ID, and exits. The catalog interface has no backup recording operation. A successful job does not create the record read by /system/backups or retain full release/migration/checksum context for discovery and restore. This source gap persists independently of provider runtime availability.
findings.repair_scope: Persist an immutable manifest and application catalog entry with artifact reference/release identity/checksum; define failed-job and catalog-commit reconciliation so artifact-only completion cannot masquerade as a recoverable catalog record.
findings.repair_acceptance: Isolated backup yields one discoverable catalog entry plus durable manifest; process restart preserves it; retrieved bytes match manifest; injected catalog/storage failure does not report complete application backup; explicit isolated restore reproduces DB/files before restore-proven status.

findings.title: R2 adapter cannot enumerate objects for the retention implementation
findings.business_impact: expireBackupArtifacts always calls store.list(), while the actual R2 adapter always throws. Even after an approved retention policy is supplied, the shipped R2 path cannot inventory or expire eligible objects. No current deletion failure is claimed because no policy/job was run.
findings.repair_scope: Provide controlled paginated R2 inventory or catalog-backed enumeration compatible with retention; preserve protected recovery chains and approved-policy gates.
findings.repair_acceptance: Multi-page synthetic inventory covers eligible/protected objects; unapproved policy deletes none; approved expiry preserves last valid recovery chain; provider listing failure is explicit and performs no deletion.

findings.title: Telemetry configuration has no wired exporter
findings.business_impact: OTEL variables are parsed but active providers remain no-ops; repository search found no production caller of setTelemetryProviders. Metric/span call sites therefore supply no exported operational evidence or alert delivery. Optional unset configuration is not itself a configuration defect.
findings.repair_scope: After backend required/optional decision, wire an approved exporter or explicitly retain documented disabled capability. Implement bounded redaction and non-blocking failure isolation before operational claims.
findings.repair_acceptance: Approved backend receives sanitized request/outbox metrics and traces; exporter outage leaves business transaction outcome unchanged; alerts tested through authorized receiver; disabled optional mode remains honest.

findings.title: Canonical release gate reconciliation remains an unconditional deny
findings.business_impact: hasReconciledProductionGateDecision returns false. Signed intake and production approval are intentionally blocked until the approved nineteen-gate register and acceptance/artifact rules exist. Correct fail-closed behavior prevents release, while functionality remains partial.
findings.repair_scope: Obtain approved canonical nineteen IDs/names/applicability/source evidence and mapping first; implement candidate-bound reconciliation and artifact verification without weakening deny-by-default.
findings.repair_acceptance: Missing/unapproved/stale/other-candidate register denies; approved complete register maps every required gate and recomputed artifact; real signed UAT/provider evidence is separately required.

findings.title: Search does not escape the declared LIKE escape character
findings.business_impact: The pattern escapes percent/underscore but not backslash while every ILIKE declares backslash as ESCAPE. Literal searches containing backslash change the next character/wildcard interpretation; e.g. a backslash before percent can restore wildcard behavior within already-authorized rows. This is search correctness, not a demonstrated authorization bypass.
findings.repair_scope: Escape backslash before percent and underscore in a shared literal-LIKE pattern builder; preserve authorization predicates before total/page.
findings.repair_acceptance: PostgreSQL fixture titles containing literal backslash, percent, underscore and combined forms return exact expected authorized rows/counts across cursor pages; foreign-scope controls remain zero.

findings.title: Scheduled backup/drill and worker execution are not wired in the deployment source
findings.business_impact: CalendarBackupScheduler constructs test-environment commands only; monthly drill CLI exits with an isolated-target requirement; render.yaml defines only a web service. The outbox CLI processes one batch and exits. There is no source-wired durable cadence, loop, worker heartbeat or external paging. This does not establish current provider configuration.
findings.repair_scope: After owner approval, wire a durable scheduler/worker execution path with bounded retries, heartbeat, monitored failure and explicit isolated drill target; do not auto-activate billable resources.
findings.repair_acceptance: Restart-safe schedule identity, duplicate tick denial, worker crash/reclaim, backlog drain and heartbeat aging verified; isolated monthly drill and approved failure alert exercised with candidate identity.
